cast_dialogue.linea: On and off, heroes: the switch of the English language. Continuation or cancellation, connection or departure — all in one tiny word.
I was nervous before my exhibition, but I carried on preparing. Hold on — my alarm is going off!
The judges put off the announcement, but the show went on. Then I set off to collect my prize.
I tried on three dresses before the party. In the end I put on the red one and took off the tags.
When I was young, the lights went off every evening. We carried on talking by candlelight. Switch off your phones and talk, mis héroes!

banco_oraciones.oracion: She carried on working despite the noise.
They put off the meeting until Friday.
He set off early to avoid the traffic.
The alarm didn't go off this morning.
They didn't call off the match.
She didn't take off her coat.
What time did you set off?
Did the show go on after the break?
Can I try on this jacket?
Did they call off the wedding? No, they didn't.
Did the lights go off? Yes, they did.
Did you carry on working? Yes, I did.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: 'On' suggests continuation or connection (carry on, go on, work on, put on). 'Off' suggests separation, cancellation or departure (put off, call off, take off, set off, go off). Note: 'put off' = postpone; 'call off' = cancel completely.

filas: carry on, go on, work on, hold on
put on, try on, turn on
set off, take off, turn off, go off

ejercicios.pregunta: Tell a short story of a journey or event using three phrasal verbs with on/off.
ejercicios.respuesta: We set off at six, but the car alarm went off twice. We carried on driving and arrived on time.

guion: Sofía: How was the cooking competition, Kenji?
Kenji: Stressful! The judges put off the announcement for an hour.
Sofía: Oh no! Did the show go on?
Kenji: Yes, we carried on cooking. Then suddenly the lights went off!
Kenji: Someone shouted 'hold on!', and two minutes later everything went on as normal.
Kenji: They called my name! I took off my apron and set off to collect my prize.

reading.texto: Kenji was nervous before the cooking competition, but he carried on preparing his ramen. When the judges put off the announcement, the crowd waited patiently. Suddenly the lights went off, and someone shouted to hold on. Two minutes later the show went on, and the judges called Kenji's name. He took off his apron, put on a big smile, and set off to collect his prize.

preguntas.afirmacion: Kenji stopped cooking when he was nervous.
The lights went off during the show.
Kenji kept his apron on to collect the prize.
